findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_revenue_goal_status, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase · Private data: quote_verify_evidence, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase · Public sink: quote_verify_evidence, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase · Destructive: quote_verify_evidence, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase, verify_evidence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_revenue_goal_status, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase · Private data: quote_verify_evidence, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase · Public sink: quote_verify_evidence, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase · Destructive: quote_verify_evidence, prepare_verify_evidence_purchase, verify_evidence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
